title: Graded Algebras over Polynomial Rings
summary: Given a trivially graded polynomial ring $A=K[a_1,\dots,a_m]$ over a field $K$ and a positively graded polynomial ring $P=A[x_1,\dots,x_k]$, we study graded rings $R=P/I$, where $I$ is a homogeneous ideal in $P$ such that $I\cap A = \{0\}$. The corresponding morphism $Θ: {\rm Spec}(R) \rightarrow {\rm Spec}(A) = \mathbb{A}^m_K$ is used to prove that ${\rm Spec}(R)$ is connected.
